added_failures_note: The reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite block and its run directory contains no suite arm (it is a docs-evidence node with no test file), so there is no measured delta to difference; 0 and an empty list record that absence rather than a clean pair, and the gate that did run is the single --check named in its tests line.
call_sites_note: reckon/crew/reports.py:2873-2877 composes the plan record over the changed fragments at promotion and calls reckon/doccheck.audit_composed_record_ids or audit_fragment_ids; run against the reviewed tree these return 0 findings at 69f816c6f and 17 duplicate-element-id findings against the 5b3bc32 pages, so the guard is shown to see a known-present collision before its absence is reported.
findings: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/reference-set.py:1323 non-blocking: self_test holds the only in-repo assertion that the two pages never share an element id and that a moved packet is refused, but neither --check nor any repository gate runs it, so deleting the page_problems call there leaves the gate green; the id half is still covered in production by the promotion check reckon/doccheck.audit_fragment_ids, the digest half only by the manual reference-set-negative-control.log.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/reference-set.py:351 non-blocking: header_layout now inherits blind-audit.py:444 clip, which squashes internal whitespace and truncates description at 1500 and documentation at 3000 characters, so a stored record over the limit would no longer re-render to the bytes its digest covers; measured today 0 of 215 packets differ between 5b3bc32 and 69f816c6f and 0 descriptions exceed the limit, so the risk is latent rather than present.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/reference-set.py:1012 non-blocking: check_problems validates every packet digest and field but never re-derives data['blind']['verdicts_digest'] from the sealed answer file, so the gate cannot show that the blind answers were committed before the earlier verdicts were opened.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/reference-set.py:574 non-blocking: three-blank-line runs at :574 and :596 break the module's own two-blank-line separation; the repository's ruff configuration does not select E303, so no gate reports it.

item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when at prompt.txt:162 asks for packets, right names, definition points, unit, group and a quoting reason, a blind re-read with changed verdicts listed beside the rule, the 52 omits-source members re-classed with counts, >=100 members with >=20 defective, and a digest check that fails on mismatch; reference-set.py:1012 enforces the field and threshold measures and reference-set-check.log records 'checked 176 members, every packet digest matches, 47 defective, 0 undecidable' at 69f816c6f.
item_verdicts.goal: Source prompt.txt:38 sets the goal 'Build the reference set of right answers re-read under the rule that a name identifies and its definition specifies'; the landed docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/reference-set.json decodes to 176 set members, each carrying its packet, right name(s), definition points, unit, group and a quoting reason, and reference-set.py:1281 renders them as the committed page and fragment.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; manifest.md records status complete, the eight commits 8539e2b..69f816c, the --check gate log at 69f816c6f, a red negative control naming acceleration_of_sensor, and counts 176 in set / 47 defective / 0 undecidable / 0 unjudged that both its gate log and the committed JSON reproduce.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the manifest's orientation_write_paths list of five paths; the diff changes exactly docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/reference-set.py, reference-set.json, reference-set.html and scfg-reference-set.html, all declared, and no other file; the fifth path docs/figures/sn-case-file-generation/scfg-reference-set carries no file, which the done_when does not require.

justifications.durability: reference-set.py:1323 self_test asserts the two pages share no id and that a moved packet is refused, and reckon/doccheck.audit_fragment_ids does report 17 duplicate-element-id findings against the 5b3bc32 pages and 0 against 69f816c6f, but nothing runs --self-test so the digest refusal rests only on reference-set-negative-control.log.
justifications.evidence: reference-set-check.log records 'checked 176 members, every packet digest matches, 47 defective, 0 undecidable' with EXIT=0 at revision 69f816c6f, and reference-set.py:1012 enforces the >=100-member, >=20-defective and per-member field measures, but no gate verifies the sealed-verdict digest or the changed-verdict listing.
justifications.fit: reference-set.py follows the sibling evidence-script idiom (pydantic answer model, sibling module loading, zlib/base85 payload, prefixed element ids) and passes ruff check, though :574 and :596 each hold a three-blank-line run against the module's own two-blank separation.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/reference-set.json decodes to 176 members whose member_entry rows (reference-set.py:844) carry the stored packet, right names, definition points, unit, group and a quoting reason, beside population.read 215 and reclassification.population 52.
justifications.reuse: reference-set.py:351 now asks the owner blind-audit.py:451 render_user_prompt for the packet header layout instead of keeping a second copy, and source packets come from equilibrium-adjudication.packets() and reader-calibration.source_packets(); no package-level owner exists for the payload codec or wilson helper that sibling fragments also carry inline.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff e2ea2a6..69f816c6f is one of the four declared fragment paths and no plan, figure, state or source file is touched.
